basic_profile.bio: Avid tech enthusiast and Tolkien aficionado living in the Pacific Northwest. By day, I'm a software engineer working on mobile app development, and by night, I'm engrossed in the latest fantasy novels or exploring the cosmos through sci-fi literature. I enjoy weekends hiking with my partner and our two Labradors. Typically active online in the evenings after work, or during lunch breaks. Dislike low-quality tech products and clickbait headlines.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in the tech industry, I have a solid understanding of smartphone hardware and software. I regularly keep up with tech news and product reviews, often sharing insights from my professional experience and personal hobbies.
